body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News>

CES proves to be the ideal launching pad for new tech products each January. Case manufacturing company OtterBox® plans to reveal an entirely new product line during the international event this year! With an infallible reputation as an industry leader in the design and production of protective solutions for mobile devices, OtterBox will showcase its high-quality cases during CES 2011 and will introduce a revolutionary series.
